semanticDecisions: the stock reverse single-unit search is a scalar loop (the flat String's own lastIndexOf(char) over 16384 units costs 6..15 us) while the forward one is an intrinsic: a window is first tested forward, and only a window holding the unit is walked back, at most the window's length; the graded windows from the end keep a frequent unit's walk-back short

the reverse block walk now hands off like the forward one under the A37 rule (eight lookups in at most sixteen walked blocks); the lane it hands to is now cheaper than the walk it leaves, which the A37 measurement of the scalar lane was not
hits found through the exact masks inside the first blocks are unchanged; a hit after the hand-off is found by the graded windows from that point
